blurb: A railway station of 1900, turned into the museum of the Impressionists.

facts.h: A station for the 1900 World's Fair
facts.t: The Gare d'Orsay was built for the 1900 Exposition. Its platforms became too short for modern trains, and after years of plans to knock it down it reopened as a museum in 1986. The big station clock still keeps time.

It holds the world's largest Impressionist collection, including Renoir's dance at the Moulin de la Galette, Monet's Rouen Cathedral series and Van Gogh's swirling self-portrait from Saint-Rémy, 1889.
